title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC/24
source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLII-S90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Recording suffers from swapped left/right channels; no musical details available.
ai_review.review: The only feedback points out that the stereo channels are reversed (L→R, R→L), which makes the listening experience confusing and detracts heavily from any enjoyment. No comments on the performance, setlist or band members were provided, so the show itself cannot be evaluated.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a single brief review noting a serious technical flaw (channel swap); no information on musical performance leads to a very low overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Left and right channels are swapped, causing reversed stereo imaging and making the recording difficult to listen to.
